<style>
.zt-rich-editor {
  min-height: 220px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  outline: none;
}

.zt-rich-editor:focus {
  border-color: #2563eb;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
}

.zt-rich-editor p {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {

  /**
   * ========================================================
   * REQUEST DETAILS VALIDATION
   *
   * Supports both:
   *
   * 1. Standard Request Details form
   *    - sf_Topic__c
   *    - sf_Sub_Topic__c
   *
   * 2. Multiple Subtopics form
   *    - sf_Sub_Topic__c only
   * ========================================================
   */

  function getRequestFields() {
    return {
      topic: document.getElementById('sf_Topic__c'),
      subtopic: document.getElementById('sf_Sub_Topic__c')
    };
  }


  /**
   * Determine whether the current node contains
   * one of our forms.
   */
  function hasRequestForm() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    return !!fields.subtopic;
  }


  /**
   * Validate whichever fields exist on the node.
   */
  function requestDetailsAreValid() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    /*
     * No relevant form on this node.
     */
    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return true;
    }

    var subtopicValue =
      String(fields.subtopic.value || '').trim();

    /*
     * Multiple Subtopics form:
     * only Subtopic exists.
     */
    if (!fields.topic) {
      return subtopicValue !== '';
    }

    /*
     * Standard Request Details form:
     * Topic + Subtopic both exist.
     */
    var topicValue =
      String(fields.topic.value || '').trim();

    return (
      topicValue !== '' &&
      subtopicValue !== ''
    );
  }


  /**
   * Create the validation message.
   */
  function ensureValidationMessage() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return null;
    }

    /*
     * Standard Request Details form has a grid.
     */
    var container =
      document.querySelector('.zt-form-grid');

    /*
     * Multiple Subtopics form does not use the grid,
     * so use the Subtopic field wrapper instead.
     */
    if (!container) {
      container =
        fields.subtopic.closest('.zt-form-field');
    }

    if (!container) {
      return null;
    }

    var existing =
      container.querySelector(
        '.zt-request-validation-error'
      );

    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    var error =
      document.createElement('div');

    error.className =
      'zt-request-validation-error';

    error.setAttribute(
      'role',
      'alert'
    );

    error.setAttribute(
      'aria-live',
      'polite'
    );

    /*
     * Different message depending on form type.
     */
    if (fields.topic) {
      error.textContent =
        'Please select both Topic and Subtopic before continuing.';
    } else {
      error.textContent =
        'Please select a Subtopic before continuing.';
    }

    container.appendChild(error);

    return error;
  }


  /**
   * Show validation errors.
   */
  function showValidationErrors() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return;
    }

    var error =
      ensureValidationMessage();

    var subtopicMissing =
      String(
        fields.subtopic.value || ''
      ).trim() === '';

    /*
     * Topic only needs validation if it exists.
     */
    var topicMissing = false;

    if (fields.topic) {
      topicMissing =
        String(
          fields.topic.value || ''
        ).trim() === '';
    }


    if (fields.topic) {
      fields.topic.classList.toggle(
        'zt-required-invalid',
        topicMissing
      );

      fields.topic.setAttribute(
        'aria-invalid',
        topicMissing
          ? 'true'
          : 'false'
      );
    }


    fields.subtopic.classList.toggle(
      'zt-required-invalid',
      subtopicMissing
    );

    fields.subtopic.setAttribute(
      'aria-invalid',
      subtopicMissing
        ? 'true'
        : 'false'
    );


    if (error) {
      error.classList.toggle(
        'is-visible',
        topicMissing || subtopicMissing
      );
    }


    /*
     * Focus first missing field.
     */
    if (
      fields.topic &&
      topicMissing
    ) {
      fields.topic.focus();
    } else if (subtopicMissing) {
      fields.subtopic.focus();
    }
  }


  /**
   * Refresh validation after the user changes
   * one of the dropdowns.
   */
  function refreshValidationState() {
    var fields = getRequestFields();

    if (!fields.subtopic) {
      return;
    }

    var subtopicMissing =
      String(
        fields.subtopic.value || ''
      ).trim() === '';

    var topicMissing = false;

    if (fields.topic) {
      topicMissing =
        String(
          fields.topic.value || ''
        ).trim() === '';

      fields.topic.classList.toggle(
        'zt-required-invalid',
        topicMissing
      );
    }


    fields.subtopic.classList.toggle(
      'zt-required-invalid',
      subtopicMissing
    );


    var error =
      document.querySelector(
        '.zt-request-validation-error'
      );

    if (error) {
      error.classList.toggle(
        'is-visible',
        topicMissing || subtopicMissing
      );
    }
  }


  /**
   * Bind fields after node render.
   */
  whenEvent(
    'render:finish',
    function () {

      var fields =
        getRequestFields();

      /*
       * Neither supported form is present.
       */
      if (!fields.subtopic) {
        return;
      }


      ensureValidationMessage();


      /**
       * Bind Topic if this is the standard form.
       */
      if (
        fields.topic &&
        !fields.topic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound
      ) {

        fields.topic.addEventListener(
          'change',
          function () {

            assignSessionVar(
              'sf_Topic__c',
              fields.topic.value
            );

            refreshValidationState();
          }
        );

        fields.topic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound =
          'true';
      }


      /**
       * Bind Subtopic for both form types.
       */
      if (
        !fields.subtopic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound
      ) {

        fields.subtopic.addEventListener(
          'change',
          function () {

            assignSessionVar(
              'sf_Sub_Topic__c',
              fields.subtopic.value
            );

            refreshValidationState();
          }
        );

        fields.subtopic.dataset
          .requiredValidationBound =
          'true';
      }


      /*
       * Don't show errors immediately when the
       * node first loads.
       */
      if (fields.topic) {
        fields.topic.classList.remove(
          'zt-required-invalid'
        );
      }

      fields.subtopic.classList.remove(
        'zt-required-invalid'
      );
    }
  );


  /**
   * ========================================================
   * NAVIGATION GUARD
   * ========================================================
   */
  document.addEventListener(
    'click',
    function (event) {

      var fields =
        getRequestFields();

      /*
       * No supported form on this node.
       */
      if (!fields.subtopic) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Allow the user to interact with the form itself.
       */
      if (
        event.target.closest(
          '.zt-form-card'
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Only inspect clickable navigation controls.
       */
      var navigationControl =
        event.target.closest(
          'button, a, input[type="button"], input[type="submit"]'
        );

      if (!navigationControl) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Valid form: allow navigation.
       */
      if (requestDetailsAreValid()) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Invalid form: stop navigation.
       */
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();

      showValidationErrors();

    },
    true
  );

})();
</script>

<script>
whenEvent('render:finish', () => {
  const editor = document.getElementById('htmlBodyEditor');
  const hidden = document.getElementById('HtmlBody');

  if (!editor || !hidden) return;

  hidden.value = editor.innerHTML;

  if (!editor.dataset.boundHtmlSync) {
    editor.addEventListener('input', () => {
      hidden.value = editor.innerHTML;
    });
    editor.dataset.boundHtmlSync = 'true';
  }
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  /**
   * Shows or hides the thumbs-down comments section.
   */
  function setCommentsVisibility($widget, shouldShow) {
    var $comments = $widget.find('.ai-feedback-comments');

    $comments
      .toggleClass('is-visible', shouldShow)
      .attr('aria-hidden', shouldShow ? 'false' : 'true');

    if (shouldShow) {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        $comments.find('.ai-feedback-comments-input').trigger('focus');
      }, 0);
    }
  }

  whenEvent('render:finish', function () {
    var $widgets = jQuery('.ai-feedback-wrap');

    if (!$widgets.length) return;

    $widgets.each(function () {
      var $widget = jQuery(this);

      if ($widget.data('ai-feedback-bound')) return;
      $widget.data('ai-feedback-bound', true);

      /*
       * Handle thumbs-up and thumbs-down selection.
       */
      $widget.on('click', '.ai-feedback-btn', function () {
        var $btn = jQuery(this);
        var feedbackValue = $btn.attr('data-feedback');
        var $hidden = $widget.find(
          'input[name="ai_feedback"]'
        );
        var $commentsInput = $widget.find(
          'textarea[name="ai_feedback_comments"]'
        );
        var $error = $widget.find(
          '.ai-feedback-comments-error'
        );

        // Highlight the selected thumb.
        $widget
          .find('.ai-feedback-btn')
          .removeClass('selected');

        $btn.addClass('selected');

        // Update the hidden Zingtree form-data field.
        $hidden.val(feedbackValue);

        // Clear any previous validation message.
        $error.text('');

        if (feedbackValue === 'thumbs_down') {
          /*
           * Stay on this screen and allow the user to explain
           * why the generated email was not helpful.
           */
          setCommentsVisibility($widget, true);
        } else {
          /*
           * Hide and clear comments if the user changes their
           * selection from thumbs-down to thumbs-up.
           */
          setCommentsVisibility($widget, false);
          $commentsInput.val('');

          assignSessionVar(
            'ai_feedback_comments',
            ''
          );
        }

        assignSessionVar(
          'ai_feedback',
          feedbackValue
        );
      });

      /*
       * Keep ai_feedback_comments synchronized while typing.
       */
      $widget.on(
        'input',
        '.ai-feedback-comments-input',
        function () {
          var comments = jQuery(this).val();

          assignSessionVar(
            'ai_feedback_comments',
            comments
          );

          $widget
            .find('.ai-feedback-comments-error')
            .text('');
        }
      );

      /*
       * Submit the thumbs-down feedback after comments
       * have been entered.
       */
      $widget.on(
        'click',
        '.ai-feedback-submit',
        function () {
          var comments = String(
            $widget
              .find('.ai-feedback-comments-input')
              .val() || ''
          ).trim();

          var $error = $widget.find(
            '.ai-feedback-comments-error'
          );

          /*
           * Remove this validation block if comments should
           * be optional.
           */
          if (!comments) {
            $error.text(
              'Please enter a comment before submitting.'
            );

            $widget
              .find('.ai-feedback-comments-input')
              .trigger('focus');

            return;
          }

          $error.text('');

          assignSessionVar(
            'ai_feedback',
            'thumbs_down'
          );

          assignSessionVar(
            'ai_feedback_comments',
            comments
          );

          do_button_click(
            8,
            null,
            'AI feedback submitted',
            'thumbs_down'
          );
        }
      );
    });
  });

  whenEvent('formDataUpdated', function (changes) {
    if (!changes || typeof changes !== 'object') return;

    if (
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        changes,
        'ai_feedback'
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    var feedbackValue = changes.ai_feedback;

    /*
     * Thumbs-up can continue immediately.
     *
     * Thumbs-down remains on the current screen so the user
     * can enter ai_feedback_comments. Navigation occurs from
     * the Submit feedback button instead.
     */
    if (feedbackValue === 'thumbs_up') {
      do_button_click(
        8,
        null,
        'AI feedback',
        feedbackValue
      );
    }
  });
})();
</script>

36.content:
# claude.md - Email Automation - INT (tree 783808640, org 605565 "Brent Thomas - Sandbox")

## Purpose
Corpay UK (Allstar) AI email automation, INT copy. Reads an inbound customer email off a
Salesforce Case, detects intent / sentiment / escalation with an AI Action, drafts a reply with a
second AI Action, shows the agent a case-review dashboard, and sends the approved reply through
Salesforce emailSimple. Runs in the Salesforce sidebar on the live tree; here it runs in Brent's
sandbox against placeholder Connected Objects, with a Test Mode that mocks every Salesforce call.
Logic is a 1:1 port of GT's "Email Automation - AI Actions INT" (109029630, org 123).

## Architecture (36 nodes, linear spine, one test branch)
1  Content  Start (root)                     -> 2 live / 32 test mode
2  Data     Get case + inbound email          sfdc_int__case_email_ai -> 3
3  Scoring  Account linked?                   is_mock_run == true -> 6; AccountId != null -> 5; else 4
4  Content  No account linked                 button -> 2
5  Data     Get account details               get_account_details__int -> 6
6  Script   Check AI eligibility              ai_account_eligibility, ai_bypass_reason -> 7
7  Scoring  Account AI eligible?              true -> 9; false -> 8
8  Content  Account not eligible              terminal
9  AI       Detect email intent               automate_email_intent_int -> 10
10 Script   Grade intent result               email_intent, sentiment, escalate_reason, confidence_score, email_analysis_route -> 11
11 Scoring  Email analysis route              escalation -> 12; in_scope -> 15; else 14
12 Script   Build escalation notice           escalation_html -> 13
13 Content  Escalation notice                 terminal (was 4 content nodes in the source)
14 Content  Case is not automated             terminal
15 Script   Set case origin                   sf_Origin -> 16
16 AI       Generate email response           automate_email_generation_int -> 17
17 Script   Build case review dashboard       HtmlBody, sf_Topic__c, sf_Sub_Topic__c, has_multiple_intents, 3x *_html -> 18
18 Content  Case review dashboard             Yes -> 19; No (manual) -> 21
19 Scoring  Multiple intents?                 true -> 20; is_mock_run == true -> 24; else 23
20 Content  Choose the Sub Topic              Send -> 22; Manual -> 21
21 Content  Make manual changes               Send -> 22
22 Scoring  Mock mode?                        is_mock_run == true -> 24; else 23
23 Data     Get incoming email addresses      get_incoming_email_addresses_int -> 24
24 Script   Build email payload               send_email_payload -> 25
25 Scoring  Mock mode before send?            is_mock_run == true -> 27; else 26
26 Data     Send email to customer            send_email_simple_int -> 27
27 Script   Grade email send                  emailSent, errorEmailMessage, email_sent_summary_html -> 28
28 Scoring  Email sent?                       'true' -> 29; else 30
29 Content  Email sent                        terminal
30 Email    Notify team of failed send        ZingtreeTeam@allstarcard.co.uk (send_now=1) -> 31
31 Content  Email to customer failed          terminal
32 Content  Test mode - pick a scenario       select test_intent -> 33
33 Script   Load example email                test_subject, test_email, test_example_body, test_example_email_html -> 34
34 Content  Test mode - review/edit email     multiline test_email -> 35
35 Script   Seed mocked Salesforce data       is_mock_run=true, sf_*, ZT.setResponseData x4 -> 3
36 Content  claude.md                         unlinked

## Data dictionary
Inbound (query params on the live launch URL): sf_Id (Case Id), sf_Subject, sf_CaseNumber, sf_ContactId.
Test Mode seeds the same names itself.
- is_mock_run (boolean, true only in Test Mode) - routers 3/19/22/25 skip the Data nodes when true.
- ai_account_eligibility (bool), ai_bypass_reason - node 6 -> router 7, screen 8.
- email_intent (comma string), sentiment, escalate_reason, confidence_score, email_analysis_route - node 10.
  email_intent / sentiment are also read by the generation AI Action context.
- escalation_html - node 12 -> screen 13.
- sf_Origin - node 15 ("Zingtree AI").
- HtmlBody, sf_Topic__c, sf_Sub_Topic__c, has_multiple_intents, case_review_html, request_form_html,
  multiple_subtopics_form_html - node 17. HtmlBody/sf_Topic__c/sf_Sub_Topic__c are overwritten by the
  zt-data inputs on screens 20/21. ai_feedback / ai_feedback_comments come from the dashboard widget.
- send_email_payload - node 24, the whole body of send_email_simple_int.
- emailSent ("true"/"false"), errorEmailMessage, email_sent_summary_html - node 27.
- test_intent, test_subject, test_email, test_example_body, test_example_email_html - test mode only.
actions.*: sfdc_int__case_email_ai.records[0] (Case), get_account_details__int.records[0] (Account),
get_incoming_email_addresses_int.records[0] (EmailMessage), send_email_simple_int.value[0] (emailSimple
result), automate_email_intent_int {email_intent[], sentiment, escalate_to_agent, escalate_reason,
confidence_score, confidence_score_extracts}, automate_email_generation_int {email}.

## External systems (org 605565)
Data Sources: Corpay UK API - INT (752) / - PROD (753), HTTP + API-key placeholders (not real).
Corpay UK SFDC - INT (750) / - PROD (751) exist but cannot host COs without live Salesforce creds.
Connected Objects (INT): sfdc_int__case_email_ai 1263, get_account_details__int 1264,
get_incoming_email_addresses_int 1265, send_email_simple_int (see changelog). PROD twins use the
same aliases with int -> prod. All endpoints are placeholder.invalid URLs carrying the intended SOQL.
AI Actions: automate_email_intent_int and automate_email_generation_int on the Open AI LLM source
(475), GPT-4o, JSON output. Prompt content: Zingtree Builder/Requirements/Corpay (UK)/
allstar-ai-actions-605565.blocks.json.
Promotion INT <-> PROD: tools/corpay_uk_env_check.py in the Corpay (UK) Workflow JSONs folder.

## Conventions and gotchas
- Aliases are frozen to the source tree's INT names so the AI Action contexts
  (${actions.sfdc_int__case_email_ai.records[0].Description}) match verbatim.
- Client-side JS in script_code (request-details validation, rich editor sync, AI feedback widget)
  is ported verbatim from the source; it calls do_button_click(8, ...) - live check needed.
- The Email node (30) really sends to ZingtreeTeam@allstarcard.co.uk on a failed send. Mock mode
  never reaches it (the mocked send succeeds).
- email_match / authorisation_required from the source were dropped: nothing read them.
- Router 7 tests the boolean (== true / == false); emailSent and has_multiple_intents stay strings.
- Bypass gate (node 6) field mapping is OPEN ITEM #1 - confirm with Corpay UK.

- 2026-09-09 Brent - initial skeleton; Claude v1-v3 structural fixes, test node, claude.md node.
- 2026-09-11 Claude - mock routers now test is_mock_run == true (a `mock == "1"` string compare fell through live and let Data node 5 overwrite the mocked account with a 400).
- 2026-09-10 Claude (Dudley/Wes) - full 1:1 port of the source's 36 nodes into this tree: eligibility,
  intent grading, single escalation script+screen, generation, dashboard (+ manual edit, multi
  sub-topic), email addresses, payload, send, grade, summary, failure email. Added the PH1
  add_update_contact_details intent (Topic "Not Online" / "Add/Update Contact Details") and the
  pre-AI bypass gate. Test Mode rebuilt: scenario select -> example email (editable multiline) ->
  mock seed -> live path with mock routers. Placeholder Data Sources + COs created live.
